name: Grand Hyatt Shanghai
insider_take: Soaring 88 floors above the Huangpu River, this architectural marvel sits atop one of Shanghai's most iconic skyscrapers in the heart of Lujiazui financial district.
whats_special: Located in the Jin Mao Tower, the Grand Hyatt Shanghai occupies floors 53-87, making it one of the world's highest hotels. The breathtaking 33-story atrium creates a dramatic cylindrical void that spirals upward, offering guests vertigo-inducing views from interior balconies. The hotel's unique position provides unparalleled panoramic views of the Bund's colonial architecture across the river and the futuristic Pudong skyline.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 79-87 for the most spectacular views, and visit the Cloud 9 bar on the 87th floor at sunset for unforgettable golden hour shots of Shanghai's skyline.
dont_miss: The stunning infinity pool on the 57th floor offers the surreal experience of swimming in the clouds, while the nearby Shanghai World Financial Center's observation deck (floors 94-100) provides even more dramatic city vistas. Take an evening stroll along the historic Bund waterfront, just minutes away via the pedestrian tunnel under the Huangpu River.
pros: Iconic location in Jin Mao Tower with stunning city skyviews
World-class dining options including renowned restaurants
Prime Lujiazui financial district location near attractions
cons: Busy urban location with heavy traffic
